trust_decision.summary: Who may read the live stream of VReplication events (applied SQL with row values, DDL, field/row/journal events) over vttablet HTTP; every sibling debug handler gates this with acl.CheckAccessHTTP(DEBUGGING), but the /debug/vrlog handler gates nothing and the fix removes the feature outright.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the /debug/vrlog route; this is its only registration and the handler has no acl check, unlike the neighbouring streamlog.ServeLogs.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP GET /debug/vrlog on vttablet/vtcombo (handler registration, deleted file)
HTTP GET /debug/vrlog (lazy endpoint registration + event producer NewVrLogStats/Send)
VReplication replay of row changes (data reaches /debug/vrlog)
CLI flag --vreplication-enable-http-log on vttablet and vtcombo

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix is a feature removal; the producer edits in vplayer.go and the flag/config edits are deletion fallout, not separate routes to the unauthorised read. There is no second implementation, wrapper or per-workflow override: NewVReplicationConfig has no key for EnableHttpLog (go/vt/vttablet/common/config.go:136-258).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no O2 site or O8 route to dismiss. A solver could argue the endpoint is off by default (go/vt/vttablet/common/flags.go:94) and that acl.CheckAccessHTTP is a no-op without a configured security policy, but adding the same DEBUGGING check that every sibling uses fully closes it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: vttablet/vtcombo must still start when --vreplication-enable-http-log is passed (the fix keeps it as a deprecated no-op), and vplayer's per-phase QueryCount/QueryTimings stats next to the producer must keep recording; removing the flag outright or ripping the stats block breaks startup or metrics.

O6_input_shapes: timeout and limit query parameters on /debug/vrlog (go/vt/vttablet/tabletmanager/vreplication/vrlog.go:80)
event types FIELD, ROWCHANGE, ROW, statement DML, DDL, JOURNAL feeding the same stream (go/vt/vttablet/tabletmanager/vreplication/vplayer.go:703-915)

O7_producer.where: go/vt/vttablet/tabletmanager/vreplication/vplayer.go:701-915 publishes into vrLogStatsLogger (go/vt/vttablet/tabletmanager/vreplication/vrlog.go:37,68); the endpoint itself is registered lazily from the producer path (go/vt/vttablet/tabletmanager/vreplication/vrlog.go:52-55)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-workflow override key 'vreplication-enable-http-log' in NewVReplicationConfig, so whoever creates a workflow (options.config) can enable the stream on a tablet where the operator left it off
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other VReplication flag has a matching override case in this switch; a maintainer adding the flag would naturally add the case too. It would be a defaults/merge route at distance from the handler.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second registration of the same subscriber handler on the tabletserver exporter (URL-prefixed path) or a JSON variant, without the acl check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Other tablet debug pages are registered through env.Exporter().HandleFunc (go/vt/vttablet/tabletserver/query_engine.go:316-321); a maintainer could have moved or duplicated it there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: copy-phase (vcopier) bulk INSERT statements also sent to vrLogStatsLogger
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The copy phase runs the same kind of SQL as the replay phase; extending the log to it is a natural feature request. It is a producer the handler check never touches, but an acl gate on the handler covers it anyway.

O9_family: missing authorization on a debug HTTP endpoint exposing replicated SQL data (CWE-862, information exposure)

O10_build.project_tests: go/vt/vttablet/tabletmanager/vreplication/vrlog_test.go (handler unit test via vrlogStatsHandler); TestPlayerFilters in go/vt/vttablet/tabletmanager/vreplication/vplayer_flaky_test.go:709 needs the vreplication test framework (vttest MySQL), so a hidden HTTP-level test of the handler is feasible offline but end-to-end replay tests need MySQL

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add acl.CheckAccessHTTP(r, acl.DEBUGGING) at the top of the /debug/vrlog handler. This is effectively a complete fix, which is the problem for the benchmark.

out_of_scope_notes: /debug/status_details on vttablet has no acl check (go/vt/vttablet/tabletserver/status.go:254) but exposes health details, not SQL data.
/throttlerlogz/ registers without an acl check (go/vt/throttler/throttlerlogz.go:105-107); it shows throttler rate data, not VReplication SQL.
vrlog also ignores the RedactDebugUIQueries setting that txlogz honours (go/vt/vttablet/tabletserver/tabletserver.go:2124); that is a separate redaction property.
unverified: Repo size in MB was not measured (no shell available); Vitess source is large but not believed to be over 1.5 GB.
acl.CheckAccessHTTP behaviour with no --security-policy set (believed allow-all) was not re-read; this affects how a hidden test must configure the policy.
present_in_latest not applicable: O8 is empty and no latest release was provided.
Whether a hidden test would accept 'remove the endpoint' and 'add the acl check' equally was not assessed.
